title: agent-orchestrator sandbox runtime enablement flag
description: Contract for the single feature flag that governs whether a sandbox runtime (offline / docker / firecracker) may execute. Shares the enum vocabulary of runtime names with the sandbox Runtime protocol; ships enabled:false and may only be turned ON by an explicit activation (issue #636, AO-GR-6 flag-gated-OFF doctrine).

runtime.description: The runtime this flag governs. 'offline' is the injectable fake used by tests/CI; 'docker' and 'firecracker' are declared, seam-only runtimes.

enabled.description: Always false on load. A sandbox is enabled only by an explicit activation at runtime, never by its declared document.

activations.description: How many times the flag has been turned ON in this process. 0 is the shipped state; the count exists so a gate can prove a flag was never auto-enabled.

reason.description: Why the sandbox is being (or was) enabled. Required by the operator path when a declared runtime is switched ON.

operator.description: Identity of the operator that enabled the sandbox (audit context, never a secret).

declared_runtime.description: A runtime that ships as a declared seam: enabling the flag still refuses to fabricate an execution.
